- Boundary decision: add a SearchHealthClient trait and a combined SearchRuntimeClient trait, so API health can probe search without mixing health into SearchQueryClient.
- Implementation next: patch search/API health first, then sync CLI/shutdown, Docker/docs/contracts, then run required checks.

- Added SearchHealthClient/SearchRuntimeClient and wired API health to return dependency JSON with degraded search-side status instead of hard 503.
- Added sync runner run_until_shutdown with a shutdown token, CLI --health-check, and SIGTERM/Ctrl-C handling for poll.
- Added Docker/Compose healthchecks plus docs/operations.md; scratch Dockerfile uses HEALTHCHECK NONE because it has no runtime health tool.
- Next run formatting and compile/tests, then fix any failures.

- Implemented health/shutdown task and reran required gates after the final sync shutdown fix.
- make check passed; make test passed full default suite; make lint passed.
- Docker validation: default compose ports conflicted with existing host PostgreSQL on 5432, so validated with a temporary host-port override only. docker compose ps showed api/postgres/meilisearch/sync healthy; curl http://127.0.0.1:13000/health returned 200 degraded/ok dependency JSON; docker stop API exited 0 immediately; docker stop sync exited 0 in 1s.
- Marked Story 08 Task 04 passes=true and acceptance boxes complete. Next run task_switch, commit all files, and push.
